properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Anthony, 2026-09-28: "I believe we can also remove: reflow2-friction-2026-07-25.md, SKILLS.md, COORD.md, and CLAUDE.md (maybe .gitignore if you need). In essence, I'd like to really clean up the git repo."

EACH FILE, WITH WHAT THE DESIGN HOLDS ABOUT IT:
· reflow2-friction-2026-07-25.md: a field report sitting at the root. dec:field-reports-are-untracked-because-the-repository-is-public (ACCEPTED) already says field reports are untracked and kept on the author's machine. So removing this one follows a settled ruling rather than opening a question. It stays in git history.
· SKILLS.md: a registered Artifact, the human catalogue of skills and commands. Skills are served from the binary (dec:skills-served), so this is a view, not a source. A site page generated from the served catalogue could replace it.
· COORD.md: says of itself "what stays here is the part addressed to someone who may not have reflow2 running: the handles, the conflict doctrine, and the conventions". The claim board moved into the graph on 2026-08-04. Contributor.handle is documented in the schema as a "COORD.md handle".
· CLAUDE.md: a registered Artifact (art:claude-instructions), the pointer that sends Claude Code to AGENTS.md. req:kit-reaches-the-agent (ACCEPTED) exists because a pointer placed where the harness does not read it left the whole kit invisible: "not the file Claude Code reads first".
· REFLOW2.md (not named, found at the root): the installer's pointer, written because this repo already had its own AGENTS.md. It repeats what AGENTS.md says.

OPTIONS, NONE CHOSEN:
(a) REMOVE all five, moving any content still addressed to people (COORD's handles and conflict doctrine) into AGENTS.md or onto the site.
(b) REMOVE the friction report, SKILLS.md and REFLOW2.md; KEEP CLAUDE.md as the one-line pointer it already is; fold COORD.md into AGENTS.md.
(c) .gitignore some of them (Anthony's "maybe .gitignore"). An ignored file exists only on the machine that has it, so a fresh clone, CI, or another contributor's agent never sees it.

COUNTER-ARGUMENTS, RECORDED BESIDE IT:
· CLAUDE.md is the risky one. If the harness reads CLAUDE.md first and not AGENTS.md, removing it (or ignoring it) leaves a session in this repo with no instructions. That is the exact defect req:kit-reaches-the-agent was written after. Whether today's Claude Code reads AGENTS.md without a CLAUDE.md was NOT measured here. It is one test before deciding.
· COORD.md's handles and conflict doctrine are read by humans without reflow2. Deleting them without a new home loses them. The schema's Contributor.handle description names COORD.md and would need updating.
· Several are registered Artifacts, so removing them is a design act (retire on the record), and the gates that read them (skill_lint reads AGENTS.md) need checking.
· FOR IT: five root files that are pointers, catalogues or history make the root harder to read, and each duplicates something served or recorded elsewhere.

SIZE, AS INFORMATION: every option is small. The CLAUDE.md measurement is one session start.
